title: Scenic drive to Kyzyl-Oi Village
desc: Leaving Bishkek behind, we drive out through roadside villages and climb to the Too-Ashuu Pass at 3600 m, where the road breaks through the ridge to a wide mountain panorama. The descent into the Suusamyr Valley brings a riverside picnic lunch.
From there we follow the Kok-Meren River to Kyzyl-Oi, a village tucked between steep red slopes. A guided walk through its lanes leads into dinner at the guesthouse.

title: Horse-ride to Song-Kol Lake
desc: We drive to Kyzart Village for lunch, where you can leave larger bags before the ride. No experience is needed; your guide gets you comfortable in the saddle first.
The trail crosses open fields and climbs the Uzbek-Ashuu Pass at 3300 m before descending to Song-Kol. You settle into a nomad's yurt for the night, with the stars overhead if the sky is clear.
meals: Breakfast and lunch at guesthouse, dinner at yurt

title: Ride back to Kyzart & drive to Ysyk-Kol
desc: The morning ride returns over the Kara-Kiya Pass at 3300 m, with a last long look back at Song-Kol before the descent. Lunch waits in Kyzart, where you leave the horses behind.
From there we drive to the southern shore of Ysyk-Kol, reaching Bokonbaev Village by evening. A lakeside yurt can be arranged if you prefer it to the guesthouse.
meals: Breakfast at yurt, lunch and dinner at guesthouse

title: Explore the south shore of Ysyk-Kol
desc: The day opens with an eagle hunter showing how his bird is flown, then a walk through the Fairy-Tale Canyons and their sculpted rock. Lunch is hosted at the home of mountaineer Lyubov Danichkina in Tamga Village.
From there we take in the Barskoon Waterfalls and the red ridges of Jety-Oguz before reaching Karakol, with time in the evening to explore the town if you wish.
meals: Breakfast and lunch at guesthouse, dinner at restaurant

title: Trek to Altyn-Arashan Gorge
desc: A short transfer brings us to Ak-Suu Village, where the trek begins. The path follows a clear river up through alpine forest, with a picnic lunch somewhere along the way.
You reach Altyn-Arashan in the late afternoon, in good time to soak in its natural hot springs and let the mountains settle around you before dinner.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, picnic lunch, dinner at guesthouse

title: Trek to Ak-Suu & drive to Chong-Kemin
desc: We retrace the trail down through the forest to Ak-Suu Village, then drive into Karakol for lunch.

The afternoon follows the north shore of Ysyk-Kol past Cholpon-Ata and Balykchy, turning at last into the green valley of Chong-Kemin National Park. It is a long day, so we set off early, with the evening for rest at the guesthouse.
meals: Breakfast and dinner at guesthouse, lunch at restaurant

title: Return to Bishkek & city tour
desc: We drive from Chong-Kemin back to the capital, stopping at the Burana Tower, the lone minaret of a long-gone Silk Road town. After lunch in Bishkek a guided walk takes in Ala-Too Square and the busy Osh Bazaar.
The tour closes in the city. If you would rather stay among the mountains a little longer, a walk in Ala-Archa National Park or a trek to Kol-Tor Lake can be arranged instead.
meals: Breakfast at guesthouse, lunch at restaurant
